description: KDWAS Financial Mission Taxonomy (Portfolio & Asset Management, Risk Management, Governance & Ecosystem)

secondary_codings.definition: Adjusting a single asset position to maintain target allocation.
secondary_codings.example: Swapping 5 ETH for USDC when ETH exposure exceeds 60%

secondary_codings.definition: Rebalancing multiple asset positions to achieve risk-adjusted optimal allocation.
secondary_codings.example: Reducing ETH from 50% to 30% while increasing DAI from 20% to 40%

secondary_codings.definition: Moving assets between yield sources to maximize risk-adjusted returns.
secondary_codings.example: Moving USDC from Compound to Aave after comparing APYs

secondary_codings.definition: Moving assets across blockchains to access better yields or lower fees.
secondary_codings.example: Migrating 100k USDC from Ethereum Aave to Arbitrum via Hop

secondary_codings.definition: Managing concentrated liquidity positions in AMM pools.
secondary_codings.example: Narrowing Uniswap V3 range from ±30% to ±10%

secondary_codings.definition: Rapid withdrawal of funds in response to security threats or market crashes.
secondary_codings.example: Withdrawing all USDC from Venus after detecting oracle deviation >5%

secondary_codings.definition: Passive holding with periodic health checks and alerts.
secondary_codings.example: Holding 50 ETH with price alert at $2000

secondary_codings.definition: Locking tokens for staking rewards or governance rights.
secondary_codings.example: Staking ETH with Lido for stETH

secondary_codings.definition: Managing tokens released from vesting contracts with tax optimization.
secondary_codings.example: Claiming vested UNI monthly with tax-aware timing

secondary_codings.definition: Monitoring protocol-level security signals including TVL anomalies and vulnerabilities.
secondary_codings.example: Detecting 40% TVL drop in Aave pool over 2 hours

secondary_codings.definition: Monitoring market-wide volatility indicators and liquidation cascades.
secondary_codings.example: Alerting when ETH 1h volatility exceeds 5% with >$1M liquidations

secondary_codings.definition: Tracking individual position health metrics like collateralization and liquidation price.
secondary_codings.example: Checking daily that all Aave positions maintain HF > 2.0

secondary_codings.definition: Executing hedging strategies to offset portfolio risk.
secondary_codings.example: Opening short ETH perpetual on dYdX during high volatility

secondary_codings.definition: Automatic execution of predefined exit strategies when thresholds breach.
secondary_codings.example: Repaying debt when health factor drops below 1.5

secondary_codings.definition: Adding collateral or reducing debt to prevent liquidation.
secondary_codings.example: Depositing 5 ETH as collateral when health factor approaches 1.3

secondary_codings.definition: Purchasing coverage for protocol deposits via DeFi insurance protocols.
secondary_codings.example: Purchasing $50k coverage on Nexus Mutual for Aave deposits

secondary_codings.definition: Audit and revocation of unnecessary token approvals.
secondary_codings.example: Revoking UNI approval to a contract with 180d inactivity

secondary_codings.definition: Migrating assets from EOA to multi-sig wallets for enhanced security.
secondary_codings.example: Deploying Gnosis Safe 2/3 and migrating all positions

secondary_codings.definition: Casting votes on governance proposals using voting power.
secondary_codings.example: Voting AGAINST Compound Proposal 118

secondary_codings.definition: Creating and submitting on-chain governance proposals.
secondary_codings.example: Submitting Uniswap proposal to add new fee tier

secondary_codings.definition: Delegating voting power to trusted third parties.
secondary_codings.example: Delegating 1000 COMP to a delegate with >90% participation

secondary_codings.definition: Mapping protocol dependencies to understand systemic risk.
secondary_codings.example: Analyzing Curve stETH/ETH LP dependency on Lido and Chainlink

secondary_codings.definition: Collecting governance signals across DAOs to identify trends.
secondary_codings.example: Aggregating treasury diversification votes across 3 DAOs

secondary_codings.definition: Building reputation scores for protocols and delegates.
secondary_codings.example: Reducing score for a protocol with 2 unresolved audit issues

secondary_codings.definition: Managing DAO treasury asset allocation according to governance strategy.
secondary_codings.example: Rebalancing from 80% ETH to 50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI

secondary_codings.definition: Automating recurring grant payments with milestone verification.
secondary_codings.example: Distributing 5000 USDC monthly grant with price-aware timing

secondary_codings.definition: Automating protocol revenue distribution or buyback programs.
secondary_codings.example: Executing weekly UNI buyback across 4 DEXes
